matrix_name.name: diglycidyl ether of bisphenol A epoxy resin
matrix_name.description: Epoxy foam matrix based on DGEBA epoxy powder with MeTHPA hardener and DMP-30 curing aid; prepared using a two-step limited-then-free foaming process (Limited-Free foam); reported foam density 0.401 g/cm3. The formulation was prepared with 0.75 wt% chemical foaming agent.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotube
fillers.description: MWCNT with carbon purity >99%, diameter 8–15 nm, length 10–50 μm.
